structural_evidence.interpretation: The public time, field, unit-role and archetype projection interface is structurally executable, and the formal engineering catalog joins exactly. Only 7/31 formal objects have an exact passing public semantic profile binding; the associated 21 scenario rows and 32 effect occurrences remain catalog associations, not materialized diagnosis episodes or generalization panels.

task_matrix.what_is_supported: Explicit finite strictly increasing time axes, declared public channel mapping, fail-closed missing-field handling and truth-blind archetype projection.
task_matrix.what_is_not_supported: Formal acceptance of physical validity, distribution coverage or diagnosis performance.

task_matrix.required_next_evidence: A Timer-frozen S1 development/calibration campaign with auditable normal/fault lineage groups and no row- or window-level leakage.
Freeze the mapping of materialized known-fault episodes to CAPACITY_LOSS, DRIFT and LEAKAGE and retain every applicable case in its unconditional denominator.
Separate Timer authorization and freeze for formal BIAS, INTERMITTENT and STUCK cases without adding, merging or widening UNKNOWN.
Materialize topology-linked episodes, freeze the deepest identifiable exact-match target per case and keep target identities out of model inputs.
Bind truth-blind evidence tokens and knowledge edges to the frozen reasoning rubric without using simulator answer proxies.

remaining_data_qualification_blockers.description: The formal Sat-Agent catalog join is exact at 31 objects, 93 scenarios and 145 fault/effect occurrences, but public semantic binding is only 7/31 objects, 21/93 associated catalog rows and 32/145 associated effect occurrences; 24 objects remain without an exact frozen-primary-capability semantic profile and no formal episode lineage is materialized.
remaining_data_qualification_blockers.no_shortcut_rule: Catalog coverage, discovered entities, semantic-profile associations or schema-compatible traces may not be counted as qualified diagnosis episodes, and taxonomy effects may not be inferred into G1 mechanism classes.

remaining_data_qualification_blockers.description: The historical report inventory retains 47 empty traces, 176 duplicate physical traces and four cross-annotation conflicts.
remaining_data_qualification_blockers.no_shortcut_rule: These records remain visible; none may be deleted, skipped, silently deduplicated across a frozen denominator or treated as independent observations.

remaining_data_qualification_blockers.description: The grouped-holdout audit establishes zero active preregistered holdout axes in current governed evidence: object-instance, configuration-family, material campaign-family, operating-condition, grouped draw/seed and episode-level archetype prerequisites all remain unmaterialized or unproven.
remaining_data_qualification_blockers.no_shortcut_rule: Renamed IDs, seeds, aliases or multiple Sat-Agent backends do not create a new source or a valid holdout.

remaining_data_qualification_blockers.description: The seven deterministic replays are nominal TEST_ONLY smoke fixtures, permanently excluded from every later split.
remaining_data_qualification_blockers.no_shortcut_rule: Their exact replay result cannot be used as training, calibration, validation, acceptance or diagnosis-performance evidence.

remaining_data_qualification_blockers.description: A formal-capability header audit found that 21 of the 24 missing exact profiles have safe common public fields awaiting manual semantic review, while three profile gaps include 14 newly discovered missing-time entities across four formal capabilities. These 14 records were outside the completed 57-file repair target set.
remaining_data_qualification_blockers.no_shortcut_rule: Do not auto-infer quantity/port/archetype meaning from names, synthesize time, reuse the prior 57-file authorization or exclude the 14 new failures. Additional Sat-Agent writes require new project-owner approval.

claim_boundary: S0 task-suitability audit only. The Sat-Agent source, independent environment, public semantic structure and sampled TEST_ONLY replay are verified, but diagnosis-task data qualification remains blocked. No fit, seed, split, performance, Stage S1, Stage B, G2, G3, cross-source or flight claim is authorized.
